Their long dark hair, styled straight and with pigtails for the woman on the right, swings with the force of their sharp turns. They then turn back to face the camera, executing a series of playful hand gestures near their faces. The background remains static and clean, emphasizing their physical performance. The text '20010731' is visible at the bottom of the doors, alongside other numeric labels that stay constant in the frame. (4) The twins conclude their performance with a sequence of fast footwork and synchronized pointing towards the camera. Their movements remain perfectly timed with one another, showcasing high levels of coordination. The video maintains a full-body shot size throughout, capturing their entire silhouettes. They end in a coordinated final pose, both smiling warmly as the action settles, with the neon sign continuing to glow in the upper right background.
